name: Podcast Episode Planning
description: Produces a complete podcast episode brief with episode thesis, guest briefing, segment structure with timing, transition language, show notes template, and SEO-optimized episode description. Use when the user asks to plan a podcast episode, structure a podcast recording session, or create an episode outline. Do NOT use for interview-specific question preparation (use podcast-interview-guide), audio post-production settings (use audio-editing-guide), or video podcast storyboarding (use video-storyboard).
